metadata.title: fix: bump dependency pins and resolve grpc/protobuf version conflict
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
## Summary
- Fix `protobuf` pin from `>=6.31.1` to `>=5.29.0,<7.0.0` to resolve unresolvable conflict with `grpcio-reflection 1.78.x` (which caps protobuf at `<7.0.0`)
- Bump `pyjwt>=2.12.1` (CVE-2026-32597), `pyasn1>=0.6.3` (CVE-2026-30922), pin `tornado>=6.5.5` (CVE-2026-31958)
- Bump `filelock`, `sse-starlette`, `uvicorn`, `memray`, `python-owasp-zap-v2.4`, and langchain ecosystem packages

commits.message:
fix: bump dependency pins and resolve grpc/protobuf version conflict

- Fix protobuf pin to >=5.29.0,<7.0.0 (was >=6.31.1 which couldn't resolve)
- Bump pyjwt>=2.12.1 (CVE-2026-32597), pyasn1>=0.6.3 (CVE-2026-30922)
- Pin tornado>=6.5.5 (CVE-2026-31958), python-owasp-zap>=0.1.0
- Bump filelock, sse-starlette, uvicorn, memray, langchain ecosystem

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti
